controlArms.purpose: Isolate what the diarization chain itself costs: recognition only against recognition plus diarization, all three arms on one HAP (commit fac938c0) and one clip.

increments.caveat: The NPU control arm began 0.72 C warmer and was the only arm whose ambient reading rose (28.34 to 29.69 C) while the CPU arm cooled, so its measured rise understates the backend gain; the CPU-percentage increment is the environment-independent figure.
